name: smoke-and-notify
description: Generic wrapper for smoke-testing a flowchart at small scale. Runs the inner flowchart via composition (FlowCoder command block), then messages a notify-target agent when done. Pattern: spawn an agent with command='smoke-and-notify' and command_args='<inner_command> <inner_args> <notify_to>'.

b0000003-notify-4000-8000-00000000003.name: NOTIFY SPAWNER
b0000003-notify-4000-8000-00000000003.prompt:
[Automated flowchart step — not a user message.]

The smoke test of /$1 (args: '$2') has completed. Notify the spawning agent.

Call mcp__axi__axi_send_message with:
- agent_name: $3
- sender: <your own agent name — you know it from your system prompt; do NOT default to axi-master>
- content: A concise summary (under 300 words) of what just happened. Include: (a) what the inner flowchart did across its iterations (drawn from your conversation history); (b) final state — checkpoint counts, error counts, sample output; (c) any HARD RULES violations or unexpected behavior you noticed; (d) explicit recommendation to verify primary sources (DB rows, files, etc.) before scaling.

Do not include any other tool calls or text output.

arguments.name: wrapped_command
arguments.description: Name of the inner flowchart to run (no leading slash). Becomes $1.

arguments.name: wrapped_args
arguments.description: Shell-style argument string for the inner flowchart. Becomes $2. Use empty string if no args.

arguments.name: notify_to
arguments.description: Name of the agent to message when the inner flowchart finishes. Becomes $3.
